blockingIssues.problem: The description says appointments may be entered "at any time during opening hours," but the source requires Saturday bookings from 7 to 21 August to enter through Gate C within the time printed on their booking.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "From 7 to 21 August they must enter through Gate C, within the time printed on their booking."
blockingIssues.constraint: Must preserve the source condition that entry is restricted to the time printed on each booking; the idea cannot broaden this to allow entry at any time during opening hours.
